partners.mechanism_chain: NR3C2 (HGNC:7877) —DISRUPTS→ Aldosterone synthesis and signaling (GO:0001077); Aldosterone synthesis and signaling (GO:0001077) —LEADS_TO→ Electrolyte imbalance (HP:0011080); TUBB6 (HGNC:25568) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal regulation in neuronal development (GO:0007010); Cytoskeletal regulation in neuronal development (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital facial palsy (HP:0000276); Cytoskeletal regulation in neuronal development (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Ptosis (HP:0000508); Cytoskeletal regulation in neuronal development (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Velopharyngeal dysfunction (HP:0000218).
